integrity: The Nijenhuis equations are independently reconstructed from the bracket rather than copied from the source example. The automorphism group and its conjugation action are derived directly, and an exact checker replays the symbolic equations and finite-field orbit counts.
scientific_limitations: The automorphism quotient is proved only for the specific two-dimensional Leibniz algebra used in the primary source example.
The result does not classify triangular structures, compatible cobrackets, or Nijenhuis Leibniz bialgebras.
A 2026 paper on triangular Nijenhuis Leibniz bialgebras was inspectable only at abstract level, leaving a bibliographic overlap risk for some representatives after forgetting extra data.
title: Automorphism normal forms for the motivating two-dimensional Nijenhuis Leibniz example
